Subject: Regional pool staging sprint — ops asklist & milestone owners

Hi Aaron / Sasha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a short staging sprint & ops asklist so we can align owners and dates before we open the Dedicated pool. Goal: have a staging pool provisioned and run smoke tests in us-west with autoscale/burst policy validated by week of 3/27.

High level asks (owners + rough ETA):
- Netops peering checklist (VPC, CIDR, firewall): Vivek — 3/17
- GPU pool size & SKU sign-off (initial reserve): Aaron + Rishi — 3/18
- Autoscale / burst guardrail proposal (min/max, pre-warm policy): Rishi — 3/20
- KV/prefix cache plan and expected token distribution for smoke prompts: Grace — 3/20
- Billing & activation trigger (billing contact + start date): Sasha — 3/18

Attachments: I attached a rough MAP (acero-map-v1.xlsx) and a draft burst policy PDF for comments. Please reply with any changes to owners or timing by EOD 3/15 so we can lock the sprint card.

Next steps on our side: Rishi will provision a single-node staging pool in us-west for validation, then expand to the requested reserve if smoke tests pass.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—Monica

Folks —

I started drafting the autoscale / burst config and uploaded a short proposal (burst-policy-proposal.pdf). Summary here:
- Staging pool: 1 node (4xA100 equiv) initially, set target-utilization autoscale to 65% with 30s evaluation window.
- Burst policy: allow short-duration burst up to +2 nodes when queue > 10 requests for > 60s; max cap 8 nodes for safety.
- Pre-warm: we will maintain a 1-node pre-warm pool during business hours Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00 PT.
- Fallback: if node allocation fails, route to hosted compatible model variant in us-west as automatic fallback (will be set in routing policy).

Open questions for Acero:
1) Is the 60s burst trigger acceptable or do you prefer a longer smoothing window to avoid oscillation?
2) Do you anticipate regular daily peaks (e.g., batch jobs) that would require scheduled pre-warm boosts?

I'll queue the staging pool provision once netops confirms peering. I can also add quantization/throughput notes after we run initial smoke prompts.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
